matter: An explanation can be followed but is not independently applied to a changed case.
scope: Constructed interpretations of this stated difficulty. No learner has been observed; final causal commitment is not supported.
standing: Constructed case, not measured learner data.

interpretation.description: A required relation is not understood.
interpretation.contribution: Identify the required relation and request an explanation of that relation with its context supplied; compare with what the next operation requires.

interpretation.description: An available approach is not brought into operation.
interpretation.contribution: Supply a minimal cue that does not provide the solution operation; compare independent and cued performance.

interpretation.description: The current prose does not expose the relation needed for an operation.
interpretation.contribution: Construct contrasting cases that expose the relation and identify which next operation becomes available.

representation.description: The existing prose remains the available representation.
representation.contribution: Inspect the distinctions and operations actually supplied by the prose.

representation.description: A relevant positive and negative case are represented together.
representation.contribution: Compare their application conditions while varying incidental wording.

commitment.description: The interpretation is used as a provisional inquiry basis.
commitment.contribution: Use its conditional consequences to choose a discriminating observation.

commitment.description: The interpretation is relied on as the completed explanation of the difficulty.
commitment.contribution: Direct a remedy on the assumption that this particular account is established.

incompatibilities.reason: This candidate specifically requires constructing contrasting cases; keeping only the unchanged prose does not supply its declared operation. This does not exclude all uses of prose.
This constructed case supplies no learner observations establishing any candidate cause. Settled causal reliance is unavailable here; every excluded assignment is retained for examination.
